dct_description_sm: The Census 2001 Population and Dwelling Counts (PDC) tables show the distribution of population and dwellings in Canada by various geographic areas, from provinces and territories down to municipalities. Data are also provided for land area and population density. Geographic boundaries are those in effect on January 1, 2001.
